response.justification: This candidate is a full-stack and web/mobile software developer with a strong career in TypeScript, Node.js, GIS platforms, and general software craftsmanship, but has no discernible experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator hardware, GPU/SIMD/MIMD architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design, which are the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, senior-level software engineering experience
Demonstrated low-latency, high-performance systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing
concerns: No evidence of SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No background in AI/deep-learning workload analysis, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD systems
Career trajectory is entirely web/backend/full-stack focused, not hardware performance engineering

key_factors.factor: No GPU/SIMD/MIMD or deep-learning optimization background
Strong general software engineering seniority and experience
